
# Shivshakti Admin - Catering Management System

A comprehensive catering management application built with React and Firebase, designed to streamline catering operations from menu management to customer quotations.

## Overview

This application serves a catering company with a multi-tiered admin system that handles everything from menu creation to customer management and automated pricing.

## Key Features

### SuperAdmin Dashboard
- **Menu Management**: Create, edit, and organize menu categories and items
- **Dynamic Pricing**: Configure tiered pricing based on guest count, event date, and other factors
- **Customer Management**: Onboard and manage customer accounts
- **Package Templates**: Create reusable catering packages for quick quotations

### Business Admin Interface
- **Customer Onboarding**: Add new customers and capture catering requirements
- **Interactive Menu Builder**: Drag-and-drop interface with automatic category formatting
- **Quote Management**: Create and Edit assigned menus and quotations
- **Smart Pricing Engine**: View suggested prices with option for custom adjustments
- **Flexible Pricing Options**: 
    - Per-item pricing
    - Per-plate pricing (overrides item-based calculation)
    - Package-based pricing

### Customer Portal
- **Quote Management**: Only View assigned menus and quotations
- **PDF Generation**: Download professional catering proposals
- **Order History**: Access past quotations and orders

## Technical Stack

- **Frontend**: React with modern state management
- **Backend**: Firebase (Firestore, Authentication, Storage)
- **PDF Generation**: Automated quotation documents
- **UI/UX**: Responsive design with drag-and-drop functionality

## Project Status

This is a complete rewrite and enhancement of an existing JavaScript application, focusing on improved architecture, user experience, and feature completeness.
